notes: THE ANDROID APP IS BACK, AS A REAL APP. A new soundLAB APK (v0.70.2) runs the live app inside it, so from now on it updates itself every time soundLAB updates — no more update prompts that download the same old version. It installs as a new app: install it, then delete the old soundLAB. (Settings from the old app don't carry over.) Also fixed: the play button next to questions in Exercises didn't respond on phones — the music staff's clef was sitting over it; and tapping text no longer pops up Chrome's Google search panel. On phones, Next scrolls into view by itself after you answer.
